integrity: Analytical proof supplied. Reproducible exact symbolic and rational checks supplement but do not replace proof. Historical-priority limits and closest common-damping result are identified. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-dimensional SPD, fixed one-vector Galerkin inverse, positive scalar complementary correction, undamped Richardson, Euclidean one-step norm; does not imply general higher-dimensional results, floating-point guarantees or Krylov performance.
title: Sharp Euclidean transient barrier for a rank-one additive reduced-basis preconditioner
